Q: What is the difference between add_action and add_filter in WordPress? A:

Use actions when you want to run code at a certain time.

Use filters when you want to modify data and return it back.

Short answer:

  • Action = DO something

  • Filter = CHANGE something

Use Action when:

You want to perform a task, not change data.

Use Filter when:

You want to change something and give it back.

No Filter Can not be used like an action because action not return value but filter does.

Real-world Examples

Example 1: Send email on user registration

Action (doing something)

add_action( 'user_register', 'send_welcome_email' );

function send_welcome_email( $user_id ) {
    // send email
}

Example 2: Change login page title

Filter (changing data)

add_filter( 'login_title', 'change_login_title' );

function change_login_title( $title ) {
    return 'My Custom Login';
}

Q: ellipsis disappeared when UILabel or UITextView has empty line A:

I found a solution: add an invisible character at the beginning of each newline character, and then the ellipsis displays correctly:

text.replacingOccurrences(of: "\n", with: "\n\u{200B}")

This is a zero-width space and will not affect the content following the newline.
